items.title: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Stock Price Stalls After Strong Q3 Earnings
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics just posted Q3 2026 results that looked firm on paper while the stock barely flinched. Shares sit at about US$241.89, down 0.6% today and only modestly higher over the past month, even as revenue for the quarter reached roughly US$3.1b and adjusted earnings per share landed near US$3.00. That muted price move appears to reflect investor caution rather than the quality of this report. The market seems to be treating a solid earnings print and raised full year guidance as...
